newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait six-month T-bill rate eases to 7.125 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait six-month T-bill rate eases to 7.125 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 50 million dinars of six-month Kuwaiti treasury bills fell to 7.125 percent from 7.189 percent last week, official figures show.
The bills were offered on Monday, issued on Wednesday and will mature on March 19.
The average accepted price was 96.569. Bids were made for 141.145 million dinars of the six-month bills.
The highest accepted price was 96.569, with a yield of 7.125 percent. The lowest accepted price was 96.581, with a yield of 7.099 percent.
The average yield at this week's tender for 53.15 million dinars of three-month Kuwaiti treasury bills rose to 6.998 percent from 6.986 percent earlier this month, official figures show.
The bills were issued on Wednesday. They mature on December 18.
The average accepted price was 98.286. Bids were made for 71.15 million dinars of the three-month bills.
The highest accepted price was 98.285, equivalent to a yield of 6.998 percent. The lowest accepted price was 98.293, with a yield of 6.965 percent.
